title: Shared primitives
description: Doc 01 section 3. Identifiers are ULIDs, timestamps are ISO 8601 with offset, and every entity an agent produced carries schema_version, produced_by and run_id.

ulid.description: Time sortable, safe to merge across machines when a bundle is imported.

visual_type.description: chart and widget are reserved for v1.1; doc 01 section 9 keeps their stubs so the block index and citation binding do not need redesign.

citation_ordinals.description: References Citation.ordinal, the [n] shown in the answer.

block_ref.description: A JSON pointer into Visual.payload, for example /root/children/2 or /rows/3/1. Doc 01 section 4.3.

effort_budget.description: Amendment A1: the harness sets the budget, the agent does not pick its own.

agent_envelope.description: Every agent output carries these. Pattern 7 plus Pattern 13 at the storage layer.
